Hangar 0.3.1 is a small fix release.

> **Not affiliated with or endorsed by Eagle Dynamics SA.** THIS MATERIAL IS NOT MADE OR SUPPORTED BY EAGLE DYNAMICS SA.

### Fixed
- **Only one Hangar runs at a time.** Starting Hangar again now brings the open window to the front, even when it is minimized, instead of opening a second copy. Two copies used to watch the same update twice: both minimized the updater window, and both wrote to the same settings and backups.
- **ETA recordings no longer overwrite each other.** If two recordings start in the same second, the second one gets its own file. Before, part of a recording could be lost, which is how this bug was found in a shared recording. Thank you for sending it!

### Under the hood
- The interface is built with SvelteKit 3. This clears the `npm audit` warnings in the build. Those warnings were about SvelteKit's server features, which a desktop app like Hangar doesn't use. Hangar looks and works the same.

### Download
- **`Hangar-v0.3.1-setup-x64.exe`:** installer. Installing over 0.3.0 keeps your settings, mods and backups.
- **`Hangar-v0.3.1-portable-x64.zip`:** unzip and run `Hangar.exe`.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: checksums for both files.

The files are not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time ("More info" → "Run anyway").
